steps: Grant access to exactly one append-only JSONL input.
Append one complete authorized conversation line and poll once.

No duplicate observation or support inflation.

steps: Append an incomplete JSON line and poll.
Finish the same line and poll.
expected: Exactly one import after completion; no lost or duplicated byte range.

steps: Replace or truncate the selected source file.
Pause observation and append another complete line.

Build the actual model context for that same plan.

The displayed plan and actual context use the same selected rules and revision.

steps: Create a candidate from exactly three independent source sessions.
Recompute the plan and discovery report.
expected: The old source quote disappears from evidence and model context.

expected: Known feedback can show the original plan and correction without model-self-rating.
